title: Intense dream
content: Two nights ago I had a dream where I was traveling. I was walking with a group that was around my age, perhaps an Army unit. It could have been 8 to 10 of us but later it was around 3. I distinctly remember it being in West Virginia, the trees and Ohio river were the telltale signs, but it wasn’t WV at the same time. It was dark and we stumbled upon a small settlement. I immediately noticed that we were in a back are of the village where hides were being tanned when I realized the hides were made of human skins. All around were masks, shields, and stretching of taxidermy that was people. We all turned to leave when a door opened at the side house around the corner. This house was in the side of a mountain, it had a lantern style electric porch light and the inhabitants offered us “rest”. Of course, we understood the trap immediately and we told them no and carried on the trail at a faster pace. We were followed of course. The dream re-loaded in a lumber mill where I was being attacked by a similar cannibal from the town. I fought him or her off and survived. This dream was so vivid and it was filled with decisions that I remember making. What does it mean, if anything?
